##: Scoop manifest for murl (Windows). JSON has no comment syntax, so
these notes live in the '##' key, which Scoop ignores.
BEFORE PUBLISHING a human must replace the placeholder hash below.
.sha256 next to the archive; that file contains the bare uppercase
hex digest (PowerShell's Get-FileHash format), no filename. Scoop
accepts it in any case. Leaving the zeros in place makes install
fail on the checksum rather than install something unverified.
Install from a local file while testing:
Publishing options: a bucket repo (thatwasyahya/scoop-murl), added
with `scoop bucket add murl https://github.com/...`, or submission
Only x86_64 is published. Scoop's 'arm64' architecture is omitted
rather than pointed at an archive that does not exist.
description: Resolve one murl:// name to a whole set of resources, under consent. Experimental.
notes: murl does not register the murl:// scheme on install. To make murl:// links clickable:
It writes HKCU\Software\Classes\murl only - per-user, no elevation, and `murl os uninstall` removes it.
The registration records this executable's absolute path, so re-run it after `scoop update murl` moves the binary.
murl-daemon (the optional resident consent surface) is not in the release archive and so is not installed here.
